  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  CITY OF NORWALK
  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  July 1, 2024

Chair Greenidge called the meeting to order at 5:59 p.m. in the Council Chambers,
Norwalk City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California. Responding to the roll
call were Commissioner Fernandez-Silva, Chair Greenidge, Commissioner Apodaca,
Commissioner Hoskins, Vice Chair Legaspi, Commissioner Pena, Commissioner Dr.
Rodriguez, Commissioner Rosoff and Commissioner Brizuela. Also present were
Richard Newton, Manager of Emergency Management, Berenia Orozco, Management
Analyst.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Hoskins motioned for the approval of minutes of the Public Safety
Commission Meeting minutes that was held on June 3, 2024. Commissioner Dr.
Rodriguez seconded the motion.

MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Chair Greenidge, Commissioner Apodaca, Commissioner Hoskins, Dr.
  Rodriguez, Commissioner Rosoff, Commissioner Pena
NOES:  None
ABSENT: Commissioner Knieling,
ABSTAIN: Vice Chair Legaspi, Commissioner Fernandez-Silva, Commissioner
  Brizuela

REPORTS

Mr. Newton welcomed Elmer Brizuela as the newest member of the Public Safety
Commission. Mr. Newton proceeded to speak on the enforcement action plan for 4th of
July, as well as laws and regulations in place to help mitigate issues that come up
during this holiday. He discussed the city’s strict “Zero Tolerance” approach towards
illegal fireworks, the first offense fine is $1,500 followed by $3,000 at the second offense
and any subsequent offense will be $5,000. Mr. Newton also shared the latest seizure
of several thousand pounds of illegal fireworks by the Sheriff’s Department. The Public
Safety Dispatch office received this tip and Quadrant Officer Gomez collaborated with
LASD to coordinate that seizure. The dispatch office and field units will be working until
midnight the day of. Additionally, there will be 19 two-man cars between LASD and our
PSO’s, a little over 40 staff will out on the field doing high saturation and issuing fines.
Each car will be equipped with a dash camera to record everything. Mr. Newton shared
the department’s determination to be as proactive as possible in handling any situation
that arises on 4th of July and explained that all staff are trained to handle any problems
that may occur.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Norwalk Public Safety Commission
July 1, 2024

Mr. Newton also shared that on July 2nd the city will be hosting the Independence Day
celebration on the lawn. During the entirety of the event, the EOC will be activated and
prepared in case of any emergency. Commissioner Dr. Rodriguez on who to contact in
case of an emergency during the event. Mr. Newton explained that she may contact any
emergency line because they will all be monitored at the EOC level to ensure
appropriate resources are deployed. Vice Chair Legaspi inquired about the way in which
the city will distribute the money collected from Illegal Firework fines.

STAFF COMMENTS

Mrs. Orozco went over the July 2024 calendar.

COMMISSIONER COMMENTS

Commissioner Dr. Rodriguez shared her concern with homes that have overgrown
grass and weeds and explained that it was a fire hazard especially around 4th of July.
She inquired if there was anything the city could do to ensure property owners maintain
their yards. Mr. Newton explained that this is a Code Compliance issue that can be
addressed. Commissioner Greenidge commented on how many Christmas lights are
still up, which is also a hazard and Mr. Newton shared that this is also a Code
Compliance issue.

ADJOURNMENT:

Being no further business to come before the Public Safety Commission, the meeting
was adjourned at 6:15 PM.

_______________________________
CHAIR
Marcelle Greenidge
